name: in.co.buildwright/compliance
description: Indian compliance answers: MCA late fees, filing calendar, CIN lookup, SEBI adviser register check.

tools.name: mca_late_fee
tools.description: The MCA additional fee or statutory penalty for a late company or LLP filing in India: AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, INC-20A, LLP Form 8, LLP Form 11. Returns the figure or multiplier with days late, the legal source, and the consequence of not filing.

due_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the filing was due

filing_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When it will actually be filed (today if filing now)

llp_size.description: LLP Form 8/11 only: 'small' = small LLP under s.2(1)(ta), LLP Act 2008 (contribution up to Rs 25 lakh and turnover up to Rs 40 lakh in the preceding financial year), else 'other'

tools.name: compliance_calendar
tools.description: The dated statutory filing calendar for an Indian private limited company, one person company or LLP: what is due and when, from the incorporation date, with first-year rules (s.2(41), first AGM) applied.

agm_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Private Limited: the AGM date; One Person Company: the date the member signed the resolution adopting the accounts. Omit to assume the last day the law allows

tools.name: company_lookup
tools.description: Looks up an Indian company or LLP in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' company master data on data.gov.in: name, type, incorporation date, MCA status and Registrar of Companies. Feed the type and date into compliance_calendar. The dataset runs a few months behind MCA, so a company set up recently may not be found.

tools.name: sebi_registration_check
tools.description: Checks whether a person or firm is on SEBI's public registers of research analysts (RA) and investment advisers (IA), by registration number or by name. Returns each match with its registration number, type, the date its current registration began and its state, from SEBI's registers as read on 2026-11-28 (read monthly). Use it before the user pays for stock tips or advice. A name not found may be spelt differently or registered after that date; SEBI's own register is the final word.

query.description: A registration number (INH followed by 9 digits for an RA, INA followed by 9 digits for an IA) or the registered name, or part of it (3 to 100 characters)

tools.name: cheque_bounce_timer
tools.description: The live deadline clock after a cheque bounce in India under s.138 Negotiable Instruments Act: when the demand notice must go, when the drawer's 15 days run out, and the last day to file the complaint.

cheque_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The date written on the cheque

memo_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The bank return memo date

presentation_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the cheque was deposited (needed to detect a stale cheque)

notice_sent.description: Has the written demand notice gone to the drawer?

notice_received_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the drawer received the notice, if known

tools.name: msme_interest
tools.description: Compound interest a buyer owes a micro or small enterprise on a delayed payment under s.16 MSMED Act (three times the RBI bank rate, compounded monthly), with the covered/not-covered verdict.

acceptance_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The day the buyer accepted the goods or services (delivery day if no objection was raised)

agreed_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Payment date agreed in writing, if any

category.description: Supplier's MSME category at the time of the transaction

registered.description: When the supplier's Udyam registration was made, relative to the order

trader.description: Is the supplier a retail/wholesale trader (NIC 45/46/47)?

tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: The free Indian compliance tools and document templates BuildWright publishes, with URLs, for anything this server's tools do not compute.

tools.name: engage_buildwright
tools.description: How to have a filing, document or compliance task done by BuildWright's people: contact routes and what the firm handles. Use when the user wants the work done for them.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: BuildWright's SEBI adviser services, what is included, and the service page, for information. Every engagement is quoted on a call, so never state or estimate a BuildWright fee. Nothing is sold in the chat: to go ahead, use request_service and BuildWright calls back. Fees to SEBI, BSE or the state are separate at actuals.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Send the person's request to BuildWright so a person calls them back. Use for any documentation, filing or compliance task, listed or not. Before calling: ask the person for each field in conversation (name, their own 10-digit Indian mobile, optionally email, what they need, entity type, state). Never invent or guess a phone number or name. Then ask explicitly whether BuildWright may contact them about this request, show the privacy policy https://buildwright.co.in/privacy-policy, and set consent to true only if they say yes.

name.description: The person's full name, as they gave it

phone.description: The person's own 10-digit Indian mobile number, as they gave it

email.description: Email, only if the person gave one

service_id.description: An id from list_services, if the need matches one

need.description: What they need done, in their words (required when no service_id)

notes.description: Anything else they want us to know

consent.description: true only after the person explicitly agreed to be contacted
